chapter_seo_title: Author Delay Notice - Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality Chapter 536
chapter_meta_description: The author apologizes for a delay with a warm, honest note. A rare glimpse into the serialization culture of Chinese web novels.
og_title: Chapter 536: A Brief Delay and A Promise
og_description: The author steps out of the narrative to explain a late update, promising two chapters by morning. A look at the human side of web novel creation.
twitter_description: Real talk: the writer shares a quick apology for a late chapter, and vows to stay up and finish. Web novel serialization culture on display!

lore_anchors.definition: A common release pace for popular xianxia web novels, often totaling 4,000–6,000 characters daily; maintaining it requires discipline and is a sign of commitment to readers.

cultural_notes_faq.a: A leave note posted by a Chinese web novel author in place of a regular chapter, apologizing for a delay and promising to make it up.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is it normal for chapters to be delayed?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Yes, real-life events can disrupt any author's schedule; honest notes like this one are well-received by the community.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does the author say "I'll stay up and finish"?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It reflects the commitment to a daily release schedule—missing it means disappointing readers who paid or waited; compensation via extra work is standard.
